name: Sole Proprietorship
definition: Unincorporated business owned by one individual with no paid employees
legal_form: Sole proprietorship; owner files Schedule C
ownership: Owned and operated by Cris Santos
it_footprint: Personal and SaaS tools: email suite, cloud storage, accounting SaaS, one laptop and phone
grc_owner: Owner, with outside IT help as needed

name: Micro
it_footprint: SaaS-first: business email suite, line-of-business SaaS, 5-15 endpoints, managed service provider (MSP)
grc_owner: Owner or office manager, supported by an MSP

name: Small
definition: Employer business with 10 or more employees that meets the SBA size standard for its primary NAICS industry
ownership: Privately held; Cris Santos is majority owner
it_footprint: Hybrid: SaaS plus one cloud tenant (IaaS/PaaS), identity provider, 50-500 endpoints
grc_owner: IT manager with part-time security/compliance duties; external auditors as needed

name: Mid-Market
definition: Business that exceeds the SBA size standard for its primary NAICS industry and has fewer than 1,000 employees
employees_rule: Above SBA standard and under 1,000 employees; where the SBA standard is 900+ employees, sized at 500-999 (Census SUSB) and flagged
sba_rule: Not small (above SBA standard) unless flagged
ownership: Private equity-backed; board with an audit committee
it_footprint: Multi-cloud or hybrid with on-premises systems, several business applications, dedicated security tooling
grc_owner: Security manager or vCISO, a small GRC function, internal audit co-sourced

name: Enterprise
definition: Single-sector business with 1,000 or more employees
ownership: Public shareholders; board with audit and risk committees
it_footprint: Large hybrid estate: multiple clouds, data centers, OT where relevant, hundreds of applications
grc_owner: CISO, dedicated GRC team, internal audit, three lines model

name: Multi-Sector
definition: Enterprise with 1,000 or more employees operating business units in three NAICS sectors (this vertical plus two companion sectors)
legal_form: Publicly traded holding corporation with operating divisions
ownership: Public shareholders; divisions report to a corporate holding entity
it_footprint: Federated estate: shared corporate services plus division-specific systems and regulators
grc_owner: Group CISO and Chief Risk Officer, divisional security and compliance leads, group internal audit
